name: net_session_browser_dialog_on_init_dialog
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::OnInitDialog initializes player/session state, populates supported DirectPlay providers, adds the no-provider fallback, selects the first row, and synchronizes dialog data. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

The smoke patches MFC CDialog::OnInitDialog ordinal 4710, USER32 SendMessageA, CWnd button/data methods, zOpt player-name access, provider-list refresh, and zLoc strings to isolate dialog initialization behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41afe0 validates the base CDialog::OnInitDialog call, player-name assignment, m_shouldEnterHostSetup and m_sessionCount reset, zNetworkDPlay::RefreshAndGetServiceProviderList dependency, provider filtering for IPX/TCP-IP/Modem display names, CB_ADDSTRING and CB_SETITEMDATA provider combo updates, no-provider zLoc message id 273 with null item data, CB_SETCURSEL 0, OK button text zLoc id 55, UpdateData(FALSE), and TRUE return.

The native smoke verifies supported-provider filtering, skipped unsupported provider, combo add/itemdata order, fallback row, selected row, player-name copy, state reset, OK text, UpdateData(FALSE), base init call, and refresh call.
